blocks.instruction: Leia o texto e escolha a alternativa correta. Algumas perguntas pedem inferência — a resposta não está escrita com todas as letras.
blocks.passage:
A warehouse is a big building where we store products. There are shelves, boxes and pallets. There is a forklift to move heavy things.

There is always a team of workers. The floor is marked for safety. A good warehouse is clean and organised.

Today you will learn 5 important words. You will also practise there is and there are. We start slow. You can do it!

items.q: What is a warehouse?
options: A big building where we store products
items.why: "A warehouse is a big building where we store products."

items.q: What moves the heavy things?
items.why: "There is a forklift to move heavy things."

items.q: Why is the floor marked?
items.why: "The floor is marked for safety."

items.q: The text suggests that a warehouse…
items.why: Inferência: "There is always a team of workers" mostra que o armazém precisa de pessoas.

items.q: The author would most likely AGREE that…
options: the reader can learn these words
items.why: Inferência: "We start slow. You can do it!" — o tom é de encorajamento.

blocks.instruction: Ouça o funcionário mostrar o armazém para o novo colega. Responda sem ler a transcrição — ela só aparece depois de corrigir.

audio.text:
Hi, and welcome! This is your first day, so let me show you the warehouse. It is a big place, but do not worry. You will learn fast.

Look here. There are many shelves. On the shelves there are boxes. The boxes are full of products. There are also pallets on the floor.

Over there, there is a forklift. It is yellow. We use the forklift to move heavy pallets. Only some people can drive it, so please do not touch it today.

The floor has yellow lines. The lines are for safety. Please walk inside the lines. There is always a team here, so if you have a question, just ask. We are happy to help.

Come, let me show you the storage area. It is clean and organised. You can do it. Let's go!
audio.label: Ouça quantas vezes precisar. A transcrição aparece depois de corrigir.

items.q: Whose first day is it?
items.why: "This is your first day, so let me show you the warehouse."

items.q: What is on the shelves?
items.why: "On the shelves there are boxes."

items.q: What colour is the forklift?
items.why: "Over there, there is a forklift. It is yellow."

items.q: Why does the speaker say "please do not touch it today"?
options: Only some trained people can drive it
It is not the speaker's forklift
items.why: Inferência: "Only some people can drive it" — o novo colega ainda não pode.

items.q: How does the speaker feel about the new colleague?
items.why: Inferência: "We are happy to help" e "You can do it" mostram um tom amigável.

blocks.instruction: O vocabulário da lição aparece aqui em frases novas. Escolha o sentido ou a palavra que cabe no contexto.

items.q: "We work in a big warehouse." A warehouse is…
options: a building where we store products
items.why: Warehouse = armazém, o lugar onde guardamos os produtos.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "The boxes are on the ___."
items.why: Shelf = prateleira, onde ficam as caixas.

items.q: "He drives the forklift every day." A forklift is…
options: a machine to move heavy things
items.why: Forklift = empilhadeira, usada para mover pallets pesados.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "Please walk on the ___. It has yellow lines for safety."
items.why: Floor = piso / andar, onde estão as linhas de segurança.

items.q: "Good storage saves time." Storage means…
options: keeping things in a safe place
items.why: Storage = armazenagem, guardar as coisas de forma organizada.

blocks.instruction: Expressões simples que ouvimos no armazém e no trabalho. Escolha o sentido no contexto.

items.q: "Can you pick up that box?" To pick up means to…
items.why: Pick up = pegar / levantar algo.

items.q: "We need to put away the products." To put away means to…
options: store them in the right place
items.why: Put away = guardar as coisas no lugar certo.

items.q: "Please watch out for the forklift!" To watch out means to…
items.why: Watch out = cuidado, preste atenção.

items.q: "The new boxes will come in today." To come in means to…
items.why: Come in = chegar (entrar no armazém).

items.q: "Let's get started." To get started means to…
items.why: Get started = começar.
